title: A bare-ticker portfolio lot is re-priced against a different listing when the session region changes: INFY 20 @ Rs1,500 shows -$29,779.20 (-99.26%) under region US, and the CSV export carries it
repro: Holding INFY qty 20 cost 1500 (bare symbol, as the add form and portfolio_add_position store it; entered under region IN where /quotes/INFY = INR 1035, P&L -Rs9,300 correct). Switch region to US: PortfolioPanel fetches /quotes/INFY with X-Vysted-Region US -> the NYSE ADR, USD 11.04; the row reads Avg cost $1,500.00, P&L -$29,779.20 (-99.26%), the header Total P&L -$28,242.30 (-88.81%), and the CSV export carries the same figures with Currency USD. Holding stores no listing or currency, so nothing detects the cost/price currency mismatch. Class sibling of R15-DATA-002 (blocked_tier4, DECISIONS 4.15): that entry's scope and its pending option (a) cover the watchlist pick and the agent add_to_watchlist leg only; the portfolio Holding (and portfolio_add_position) carry no region either, and here the harm is a fabricated money P&L, so it is filed as its own site rather than attached.
root_cause: Holding (src/store/portfolios.ts) and portfolio_add_position store no listing, region or currency; fetchPositionQuotes (src/modules/portfolio/api.ts) calls sidecarApi.quote(symbol) with the global X-Vysted-Region, so the same bare symbol binds the session region's listing and its price is set against a cost entered in another currency.
fix_shape: Store the listing (region/exchange or yahoo_symbol) and currency on each holding at add time (form, agent add, restore of older blobs keeps session-region), send the per-holding region on each quote call, and refuse to compute P&L when quote currency differs from the holding currency. Pin with a PortfolioPanel test: INFY added under IN, region switched to US, the row still prices INFY.NS in INR.
note: Class sibling of R15-DATA-002 (blocked_tier4, DECISIONS 4.15) on a surface no DATA-002 attempt touched (portfolio); filed separately per the lead's precedent in DECISIONS 4.15 (sibling note, LEAD-127). R2: a fabricated money P&L shown as true = critical (finder said high). Admitted 3 Oct by final-triage (fresh claude-opus-5-5) at d38b5d1a.

title: NSE SME GSTL (Globesecure Technologies) is stamped with BSE GSTL Globalspace Technologies' ISIN INE632W01016 / scrip 540654, so its results calendar, announcements, corporate actions and shareholding split merge a different company's BSE filings
repro: GET /resolve?q=GSTL (IN) -> NSE Globesecure Technologies, confidence 1.0, needs_disambiguation false, isin INE632W01016, bse_code 540654 (that is BSE Globalspace Technologies; NSE Emerge SME_EQUITY_L.csv gives Globesecure ISIN INE00WS01056). title: A corrupt SQLite store is never quarantined: a corrupt data_cache.db (pure cache) fails sidecar startup on every launch, and a corrupt custom_agents.db / delegate_runs.db / plugins.db 500s every route of that store until the file is deleted by hand
repro: cp -R final-seed-data fi-final/corrupt-data_cache; overwrite bytes 0-15 of data_cache.db with 'NOT A SQLITE DB!' and remove its -wal/-shm; (sleep 40 | VYSTED_OPENBB_MCP_PORT=52801 VYSTED_SEC_EDGAR_MCP_PORT=52802 ./.venv/bin/python3 main.py --host 127.0.0.1 --port 52847 --data-dir <that dir>) from final-cand/sidecar @d38b5d1a -> /health never answers; log: 'sqlite3.DatabaseError: file is not a database' ... 'ERROR uvicorn.error: Application startup failed. Exiting.' Code: app.py:125 await data_cache.ensure_build(app.version) (first thing in _lifespan) -> data_cache.py:113 _run -> :232 _get_conn -> :105 _connect conn.execute('PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL') with no DatabaseError handling; the Tauri core (src-tauri/src/lib.rs:85-90, :438-442) only announces 'The data engine stopped (exit code N).' and never respawns. Contrast: a corrupt workspace file is quarantined as .corrupt-<ts> (workspace_store.py:191-195, R15-DATA-090) and a corrupt legacy portfolio.db only 500s its one GET. Trigger is SQLite file damage (power loss / disk-full / crash during write on a laptop); rare, but the consequence is total and persistent, and the file is pure cache (safe to quarantine and recreate). Per-db matrix for the other stores in 83-corrupt-each-db-boot.txt.
root_cause: data_cache._connect (PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL, called from app._lifespan ensure_build) and agents_store._connect / runs_store / plugins_store connect with no sqlite3.DatabaseError handling, unlike workspace_store's .corrupt-<ts> quarantine (R15-DATA-090).
fix_shape: One shared open helper: on DatabaseError ('file is not a database' / 'malformed'), rename the file (and -wal/-shm) to .corrupt-<ts>, log it, and recreate; for the rebuildable cache this is silent, for user stores surface a one-line notice. Pin with a corrupt-header test per store and a boot test with a corrupt data_cache.db.
note: Same mechanism found twice in this pass (failure-inducer per-db matrix surface/failure-inducer/final/83-corrupt-each-db-boot.txt and maintainer LS-2): one item, both keys. Class sibling of fixed R15-DATA-090 (workspace JSON only). Admitted 3 Oct by final-triage (fresh claude-opus-5-5) at d38b5d1a.
